title: Around-the-horn PCR and cloning
author: Stephen Floor
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rf2d3qe

steps.title: Prepare PCR mix on ice
steps.instruction: Combine all PCR components (primers, template, dNTPs, polymerase, buffer) on ice as per your design.

steps.title: Run around‑the‑horn PCR
steps.instruction: Program thermocycler: 95 °C 2 min; then 30 cycles of 95 °C 15 s, 65 °C 15 s, 72 °C 10 min (adjust 72 °C extension to ~1 min per kb of plasmid); finish with 72 °C 15 min.

steps.title: Prepare 1% agarose gel
steps.instruction: Mix 75 ml 0.5× TBE with 750 mg agarose, microwave ~90 s until clear, add 7.5 µl SYBR Safe, keep at room temperature.

steps.title: Cast gel with combs
steps.instruction: Assemble gel cassette with appropriate combs (4–5 lanes), pour hot agarose, allow to solidify to room temperature.

steps.title: Run gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Place gel in tank with 0.5× TBE, ensure submersion, load ~10 µl DNA ladder in one well and samples in remaining wells, run at ~120 V for ~30 min.

steps.title: Excise PCR bands
steps.instruction: Image gel on blue‑light imager, cut desired bands with a clean razor blade, transfer each band into a separate 1.5 ml tube.

steps.title: Gel‑purify PCR product
steps.instruction: Purify each band using a mini‑spin column, elute in ~15 µl, measure concentration with Nanodrop (typical yields 50 ng/µl, can be as low as 10 ng/µl).

steps.title: Phosphorylate PCR product
steps.instruction: In a tube combine 1 µl 10× T4 ligase buffer, 1 µl T4 PNK, ~50 ng purified PCR product, add water to 9 µl total, incubate 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Ligate phosphorylated DNA
steps.instruction: Bring reaction to room temperature, add 1 µl T4 DNA ligase, incubate ≥1 h at RT (1 h typical).

steps.title: Transform competent cells
steps.instruction: Thaw cells on ice, add 4 µl ligation mix to 33 µl competent cells, incubate 25 min on ice, heat shock 42 °C 1 min, return to ice 2 min, add 180 µl LB or SOC, shake 37 °C 1 h, plate 75 µl on selective agar.

description: This strategy will have high background unless you remove the template DNA. DNA from most E. coli strains is methylated and can be degraded by the relatively nonspecific restriction enzyme Dpn1. Add 1 ul Dpn1 to each PCR tube and incubate for 30 minutes to overnight at 37 degrees.
